top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by heterobifunctional molecules is a new, designable chemical principle (induced proximity between a chosen protein and an E3 ligase) with unambiguous readouts and wide reproduction across laboratories. The Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli allocation gives one coherent subject, and a citation worded around the mechanism does not depend on a future drug approval. Pd-catalysed C-N coupling is the most mature alternative, and the folding landscape is third; phase separation ranks fourth because its in-cell meaning is unsettled, though any award is still preferred to none.
